scope: Pinned v126.3.cw49 archive and read-only proofs.db inspection; not a replay, correctness proof, or audit of every rule.

schema.name: log
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE log (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, depth TINYINT, reason TEXT, name TEXT, stem SMALLINT as (t-s), s SMALLINT, t SMALLINT, r SMALLINT, x TEXT, dx TEXT, info TEXT)

findings.observed: No structured premise edges in log schema; naturality logging passes only map name as info.
findings.export: Stable event IDs, tagged rule, premise references, map and endpoint witnesses; do not infer dependencies from adjacent row IDs.

findings.observed: Nested reason filtering; noncontradictory trial log rolled back; native log IDs are not durable proof-event identities.
findings.export: Append-only certificate events, explicit branch parent/assumption/discharge, preserved proof dependencies across state rollback.

findings.observed: Enumeration uses nd.first/count, mutable staircase basis, cached exclusions; resulting D/DI log has empty proof text.
findings.export: Versioned candidate span and state, coverage inputs, excluded-candidate proof links and selected result. Coverage requires a Lean invariant, not only candidate counts.

findings.observed: Logged endpoint does not serialize reduction multipliers or row-operation coefficients.
findings.export: Relation-index/multiplier combinations, module coefficients, matrix-combination witnesses. Derived relations require their own evidence or original-relation expansion.

findings.observed: Nonboundary diagnostics depend on reductions and possible-source tests in current mutable state.
findings.export: State snapshot/deltas with derivation references, row-span witnesses or separating functionals, all source-exclusion/degree premises. Prove coverage of actual boundaries separately.

findings.observed: Rule vocabulary includes manual, migration and d2 origins; enum tags alone are not root proofs.
findings.export: Distinguish assumptions from derivations, link external roots to existing manifest, bind computed seeds to resolution/secondary witnesses; never upgrade tag to proved fact.

unproved_after_export: Generic mathematical soundness of each spectral-sequence rule and state invariant
Native resolution correctness and representative/quotient comparison
Fixed-model P, map identifications, multiplication compatibility and actual source premises
